content: Ila ngo yebe yor tot mmaler Jews mo imor Gentiles? Hare yor pelal iy hagil la?
Ngo, ye palleng pelal bo metamol chog ngo Deus ye luglug le yebe kangalur Jews molwe yalol.
Hare ye wochog bo sibis ir rete taelenga? Ila ngo be yoh le sibe sor bo Deus ye towe dabey mekla yesa sor?

Te ila sengal! Deus ila yema katos le ila mwo panger yarmat ngo rema kachepar. Bo iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Yebe llahloh le ye bung mekla hama kapta; ngo habe win irel yodla rebe hatugulu kofmi.”

Ngo ye hetefa le hare yach ma foru meka ye tabung ila yema kawraloh yael Deus ma foru ikla ye bung? Meda mele sibe sor? Be yoh le sibe sor bo ye tabung Deus irel mala yema fang yach hagerger? [Iye kasiy la yebe mechrag le yarmat rebe kasiy.]
Te ila sengal! Bo hare ye wochog bo ye tayikof Deus, ila ngo be ifa sengal yal hatugulu kofer retalop?
Iwe ngo hare ye wochog bo yai tema katos ye halehaloh falmay la yael Deus le ye katos, ila ngo meda fal mele rebe hagereyey loh chog le yebe wochog bo ngang semal choto hamolfid iyang?

Meda mele site sor chog bo, “Siya foru meka ye tayikof bo yebe dohdoh meka ye momay mo iyang?” Yor tot yarmat le resa hapatpat tayikof irey le re sor bo ngang ispegil sor mele iye sengal. Ila ir rebe loh luwul hagerger la rebe faesul loh iyang.
Tor Semal Le Pangal Yad Ngo Ye Momay
Ila ngo gich Jews, ye fel igegach tangir Gentiles? Yeb, te ila sengal! Isa moal kawraloh le Jews mo Gentiles ila panger ngo re mel luwul mala kkelel molfid.
Babior we ye Santus ye sor bo,

content.text: iwe ngo tor semal le ye medaf
Panger yarmat ngo resa tagul tang Deus;
tor semal le yema foru mekla ye momay, le semal mwo ngo tor.
Mekla yewer ila ye wochog pey kowe ye sugegloh chog,
le kachepar chog mele yema buyoy mo iyang,
iwe ngo hapatpat kala chog yema lilimesloh yarmat le ye wochog poisonel parchoyoh mele yema buyoy mo iyang.
Mekla yewer ila ye ssogol ssupah kowe ye kkel yal tayikof.
Yema ttir yar hafohoyur mo yar lilimesloh yarmat.
Te tugul lobole re loh iyang,
ngo rema hattowas ngo re hafohoyur yarmat resa tahcherloh.
Re ted gola mwo mala yalepal hopos,
ngo re ted gola le rebe hasrowu Deus.”

content: Igla ila siya gola le pangal meka ye mel lal Hatobtob we ngo yor fal ngalir rechokla rema dabey Hatobtob le. Bo hare yebe hapolaho pangal yach yarmat ma ffaordah chog fael wegdeg ka yach le ye tayikof, ila ngo Deus yebe hatugulu kofer retalop.
Bo ted yor le ye fel mo fael metael Deus le fael yal dabey mekla Hatobtob la ye sor; Hatobtob la ye far foru bo yarmat rebe gola le resa molfid.
Sangsengal Yael Deus Hafler Yarmat
Iwe ngo sangsengal yael Deus hafler yarmat ngali igla ila yesa llahloh, iwe ngo tor loh igegel meka ngal hatobtob we. Le ila mwo Hatobtob we yael Moses mo profeta kowe ngo re fang yar tugul iyang.
Deus ye hafler yarmat irel yar tugulul ladep irel Jesus Kristus. Deus ye foru mele ngalir panger rechoka ye tugul lal deper irel Kristus, bo tor mele ye dil fetang Jews mo Gentiles iyang:
Panger yarmat ngo resa molfid iwe ngo resa ddaw tang falmay la yael Deus.
Iwe ngo haradiya, la yael Deus kkefang le yesa hataldagi ngalir panger rechoka resa fel mo irel, ila yesa yoh ngalir mo irel Jesus Kristus we iy mele ye taldir.

Deus ye fang Kristus bo ye bela mes bo ila ngo pangal molfidir yarmat ngo yebe chuy irel yar tugulul ladep irel Kristus. Deus ye foru mele bo yebe kawraloh le iy Deus yema foru chog meka ye fel. Muswe ngo ye halelayi repiyal ngo ye hasi bo ye tuwiri yar yarmat molfid;

Yela fael mwole ngo yesa tagul bo yebe hafler yarmat mo irel mekla molfidir bo yebe kawraloh le iy yema foru loh chog meka ye fel. Iye sengal yael Deus kawraloh le yema foru chog meka ye fel, ngo yema hafle panger rechoka ye tugul lal deper irel Jesus.
Ila ngo meda mele sibe habos iyang? Tayicchalmo! Ila ngo meda fael mele iye sengal? Hare mil mala si talenga hatobtob le? Yeb, te ila sangal, bo far mil mala ye tugul lal depach.
Igla ila siya sor le yarmat ila rema fel mo irel Deus le fael yar tugulul ladep, ngo te fael mala re talenga mokwe Hatobtob we ye sor.
Hare Deus yar chog Jews Deus? Te wol iy yar Gentiles Deus? Ngo, wol iy yar Deus.
Deus ila ye hal semal ngo ye bele hafeler Jews ngali le fael yar tugulul ladep ngo, ye wol hafler Gentiles ngali irel yar tugulul ladep.
Mele ila te fael mala sibe tahcheloh Hatobtob le, le fael tugulul ladep. Yeb, te ila sengal! Si kkatagita chog Hatobtob le.
